title: Paint the Dungeon Grey
description: Paint the Dungeon Grey — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Sir Kent the Artisan

Quest Type: Collect

Quest Description: Collect 7 Buckets of Grey Paint from the Whiskers Broodlings and Blademasters. Afterward, return to Artisan Kent on Level 1 of Algernon.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: Sir Kent the Artisan

Repeatable: No

Following Quest: Paint the Dungeon Green

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Collect 7 Buckets of Grey Paint from the Whiskers Broodlings and Blademasters. Afterward, return to Artisan Kent on Level 1 of Algernon.

Offer:

Oh, fancy meeting you here. In my living room. Where you were not invited. Bring any friends? Maybe you can kick back and put your feet up on my furniture? I'm sure you have been chugging potions like they were water, so perhaps you would like to relieve yourself over there on my bookcase full of extremely old and valuable dungeon master guides? By all means, help yourself! Harumphttttt!!!

Argh! Sorry for my bad temperament. I do not enjoy human interaction and that is why I live here, in Algernon. Less people, more time to be alone and paint. My name is Kent, by the way, and this is my home.

Say, you are one of those Dungeon Runners are you not? Well, I have something I would like you to do. You see, I am running low on paint and, instead of having to walk all the way back to Townston, I was thinking you could get it for me. You Dungeon Runners like killing creatures, right? Well, instead of heading back to Townston to buy the paint, you can just kill some creatures to get the paint. This dungeon is getting a little old and it is starting to show, so you should not have too much trouble finding some creatures that have some touch-up paint on them. The easiest paint to find will probably be the Grey Paint that the Whisker Broodlings and Whisker Blademasters carry on them. Seek them out here on the lower levels of Algernon. Once you have the paint, return to me, Kent the Artisan, here on Level 1 of Algernon.

Oh, and if my door is closed then there is a Particularly Rude Broodling around. I will not open the door until it is dealt with. So unless that broodling is dead, you can keep on knocking but you can't come in!

Turn-in:

Well done, Dungeon Runner. This should be enough Grey Paint to last me a bit. Here is something for you.

Objectives:

  • Grey Paint ×7

Client level range: 3–20
